findings.title: The implicit mandatory test profile silently selects the base optional-library adapters.
findings.scope_basis: ROOT-2D-01 requires independent base behavioral contracts and actual Kazoo LockTimeout/Gymnasium Box qualification in the mandatory profile. The accepted existing conftest explicitly defaults an unfiltered full suite to mandatory.
findings.description: Both new fixtures select the actual library only when the raw test_profile option equals the string mandatory. For the standard unfiltered pytest tests invocation, that option is None, while _ProfileChecks.full=True, qualify=True and base=False enforce mandatory prerequisites. Despite installed/importable Kazoo and Gymnasium, lock_timeout_type returns builtins.TimeoutError and action_space returns types.SimpleNamespace. This silently removes actual-library fixture qualification from the default mandatory entrypoint. Explicit --test-profile=mandatory and the clean base correction both work; this is a narrow remaining test-policy gap, not a production arithmetic or S3 defect.

reproduction.method: Real pytest.Config.fromdictargs configurations for unfiltered tests, explicit mandatory, and explicit base; current _ProfileChecks and both current fixture bodies execute. The full implicit suite/startup matrix is not run. Probe ends with a failing assertion for the implicit mandatory case.

findings.required_fix: Have these two owned test fixtures honor the effective profile, including the existing implicit mandatory mode, while continuing to run independent contracts in clean base. Add a focused regression for implicit/explicit mandatory and explicit base selection. Preserve the existing shared conftest, metadata, mandatory prerequisites, skips and negative assertions; no production or dependency change is needed.
findings.acceptance: On both interpreters, default unfiltered mandatory configuration and explicit mandatory select the real LockTimeout/Box; explicit base still executes all 13 affected cases without Kazoo/Gymnasium. Retain the currently passing 60 actual combined cases and base suite. Original author corrects this test-only gap followed by fresh independent review.
